title: Find a driver education course provider
summary: Find information about the requirements and providers for a mandatory driver education course if you exceed your demerit point limit.
intro:

faqs.q: Who needs to complete a driver education course?
faqs.a: If you hold an unrestricted NSW Driver Licence and exceed your demerit point limit twice within 5 years, you will need to complete a course.

faqs.q: Where must the driver education course be delivered?
faqs.a: The course must be delivered by a Transport for NSW-approved provider.

faqs.q: What do I do after completing the course?
faqs.a: You must present a copy of your completion certificate to a Service NSW Service Centre.

faqs.q: What if I am learning to drive?
faqs.a: If you are learning to drive, you should refer to the relevant information.

faqs.q: Do I need a different course if I am completing a Drink Driver Education course?
faqs.a: If you need to complete a Drink Driver Education course, you must complete the Sober Driver Program, not the providers listed for general courses.
